active_faults.coverage_note: GEM Global Active Faults Database (Styron & Pagani, 2020; incorporating HimaTibetMap) maps 70 Quaternary surface fault traces in the Nepal region (4 non-fault syncline/anticline folds excluded). It does NOT include continuous mapped surface traces of the Main Boundary Thrust (MBT), Main Central Thrust (MCT), or the buried 3D Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) megathrust décollement that underlies all of Nepal and generates great Himalayan earthquakes (e.g., 1934 M8.0, 2015 M7.8). Absence of a mapped surface trace does not imply low seismic hazard.

qp_piecewise.note: refit by maximum likelihood to the 63-point dataset of O'Connor & Beebee (2009) compiled by Veh et al. (2020); functional form and Student-t(nu=10) noise as published
